diagnosis.root_cause: Test expectations and fixture behavior drift: expects error.UnexpectedRow while DB immutability triggers return ServerError; ordering assertions assume insertion order under timestamp+UUID ordering; inline UUID generation leaks allocator memory.

Integration/schema mismatch: xc03 tests target repository_artifacts/activation shape not guaranteed by current migration chain and XC-03 loader/repository path is still stubbed/incomplete for those expectations.
Integration test SQL targets columns/relations that do not match current event/timer contracts (for example events inserts missing required actor_id and include tenant_id not present in schema).
Replay tests are schema-drifted (direct inserts into instances/events shapes inconsistent with current DB model), producing broad ServerError failures before replay assertions execute.
Backward-compat tests depend on legacy table/column assumptions (instances and audit ordering assumptions) not aligned with present schema/migration state, causing immediate query/insert failures.

step2_scope_decision.reason: Minimum combined fix scope exceeds WF-03 Step-02 cap (>=6 files with XC-03 requiring source+migration work in addition to test files).
step2_scope_decision.recommended_action: Escalate to ORCH to split into multiple WF-03 rework handoffs (test-alignment batch and XC-03 schema/source batch).
